title: América Latina después de la Guerra Fría
goal: Read how Cuba's loss of Soviet subsidies triggered the 1991 "Special Period", a roughly one-third economic contraction, the 1994 balsero migration crisis, and Castro's limited economic openings without political change.

items: Explain what Cuba depended on from the Soviet Union.
State what Castro declared in 1991 and why.
Describe the scale of Cuba's 1991-1994 economic contraction.
Explain what happened in the August 1994 balsero crisis.
Use quedarse sin to describe losing relied-upon support.
